title: Langkast | One workspace for all your AI work
excerpt: One workspace for all your AI work. Chat with every leading AI model, build agents, automate workflows, and connect your favorite tools — all in one place.
content_html:
Chat with every leading AI model, build agents, automate workflows, and connect your favorite tools — all in one place.

Works with the world's leading AI models.

Everything you need to work with AI.

Six things that used to live in six places, in the one place you work.

The problem isn't access to AI. It's that your AI work is scattered.

People run ChatGPT in one tab, Claude in another, Gemini for research, and keep the documents, prompts and workflows somewhere else again. Langkast brings all of it together in one workspace.

Stop switching. Start working.

Whether you work alone or with a small team, one place means less time finding things and more time doing the work.

Private by default. Yours forever.

Putting everything in one place is only a good trade if the place is one you can leave.

Your work belongs to you

Your conversations, your documents and your workflows stay yours. None of it is used to train models, and you can export all of it and leave whenever you want.

Never locked to one model

Switch models whenever you want, mid-conversation if you like. New ones appear in your workspace as the labs ship them, so you aren't betting your work on one roadmap.

Questions

The things people ask before they move their work.
